# Chapter 7: Conclusions

## 6.1 Project Achievements

The project successfully met all key design objectives, yielding a production-ready RAG system tailored for multi-hop question answering on the HotpotQA dataset. The architecture separates concerns into modular services, facilitating scaling, testing, and maintenance. Key achievements include the integration of hybrid search and post-retrieval re-ranking, and the design of a smart routing and query-rewriting layer to manage conversational context.

## 6.2 Technical Excellence

The codebase reflects software engineering best practices:
- Single Responsibility: Classes (Embedder, Preprocessor, Chunker) execute one task.
- Robust Error Handling: Custom exceptions (DataDownloadError, RetrievalError) isolate issues.
- Persistence: Async MongoDB integration preserves user state.
- Lazy Loading: Heavy embedding models and vector clients load only when needed, minimizing start-up times.

## 6.3 Future Enhancements

To build upon this work, future iterations could investigate:
- Local GPU-accelerated embedding indexing to support larger source datasets.
- Advanced post-retrieval processing, such as LLM-based chunk summarization and compression.
- Contextual semantic caching to bypass LLM generation for duplicate queries, reducing API costs.
- Extent the system to support multimodal RAG inputs, indexing tables and figures alongside text.
